blocks.title: Photoelectric effect
blocks.text: Photoelectric effect munasib frequency ya wavelength ki roshni parne par dhaat ki satah se electrons ka nikalna hai. Nikalne wale electrons photoelectrons kehlate hain.

Fig 18.1 ke saaman mein khali (evacuated) sheeshe ki tube mein do electrodes hain. Anode A battery ke musbat terminal aur dhaat ka cathode C manfi terminal se jura hai. Jab munasib frequency ki aik rang ki roshni cathode par pare to yeh electrons chhorta hai, jo anode ki taraf kheenche jate hain, aur current microammeter se napa jata hai. Roshni band karne par current ruk jata hai, jo dikhata hai ke yeh roshni ki wajah se hai; ise photoelectric current kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Kitab ki roshni rang chhanne wale filter (colour filter) se guzar kar photocell X par parti hai, jis mein cathode C aur anode A hain. Micro-ammeter A cell ke silsile (series) mein, voltmeter V us ke aar paar, aur cell potential divider Y ke sarakne wale rabte (sliding contact) se battery se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.1: photoelectric effect dekhne ka tajurbati intizam (kitab ki Figure 18.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Roshni filter se aik rang ki ho kar cathode C par parti aur electrons nikalte hain jo anode A tak ja kar current banate hain; micro-ammeter A yeh current napta aur voltmeter V cell ka voltage. Slider Y ko sarkane se voltage kam ziyada hota hai. Kitab ki shakal mein cell ka daayan taar potential divider se jura hi nahi (circuit adhoora hai); hum ne ise divider ke daayen sire se jor diya hai, warna koi current nahi chal sakta.

Photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada tawanai maloom karne ke liye battery ulat di jati hai, taake anode manfi ho. Ab photoelectrons dhakele jate aur current kam hota hai. Aik khaas manfi voltage, stopping potential Vo, par current sifar ho jata hai: sab se zyada tawanai wale electrons bhi anode tak nahi pohanchte. Is liye (1/2) m vmax^2 = Vo e (18.4). Tez roshni se current zyada hota lekin usi Vo par rukta hai (Fig 18.2). Shiddat muqarrara rakh kar mukhtalif frequencies se har frequency ka stopping potential mukhtalif hota hai (Fig 18.3), jo dikhata hai ke zyada se zyada kinetic energy frequency par munhasir hai.

blocks.alt: Photocurrent Ip aur lagaye gaye voltage (-V se +V) ka graph. Do curves, I2 oopar aur I1 neeche (I2 > I1), dono manfi taraf aik hi stopping potential Vo par sifar current se shuru hote aur mukhtalif saturation currents par seedhe ho jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.2: do shiddaton (intensities) ki aik rang ki roshni ke liye photocurrent aur voltage ke khaas curves (kitab ki Figure 18.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Photocurrent Ip aur voltage ka graph. Frequency f2 ka curve f1 ke curve se zyada manfi voltage par sifar se shuru hota hai (f2 > f1); dono oopar uth kar musbat voltage par aik hi saturation current par mil jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.3: mukhtalif frequencies ki roshni ke liye photocurrent aur voltage ke khaas curves (kitab ki Figure 18.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Fig 18.2 mein roshni tez karne se current barhta hai (I2 > I1) lekin dono curves aik hi Vo par sifar hote hain: shiddat electrons ki tadaad barhati hai, un ki zyada se zyada tawanai nahi. Fig 18.3 mein frequency barhane (f2 > f1) se stopping potential barh jata hai, yani zyada frequency par electrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy zyada hoti hai.

items: Electrons mukhtalif tawanaiyon se nikalte hain; un ki zyada se zyada tawanai dhaat aur roshni ki frequency par munhasir hai, shiddat par nahi.

Aik kam se kam frequency, threshold frequency fo, hai jis se neeche koi electron nahi nikalta, roshni kitni hi tez ho. Maslan neeli roshni sodium se photoelectric emission karti hai lekin surkh nahi (Fig 18.4). Threshold frequency har dhaat ki mukhtalif hai; mutalliqa wavelength threshold wavelength hai.
Electrons foran nikalte hain; roshni ki shiddat sirf un ki tadaad tay karti hai.

blocks.alt: Do lehriya shuaein. Lambi wavelength wali surkh shua, 'Red light (low intensity)', 'No electron emitted' par khatam hoti hai. Chhoti wavelength wali neeli shua, 'Blue light (high intensity)', 'Electron emitted (more electrons)' par khatam hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.4: sodium dhaat par surkh aur neeli roshni (kitab ki Figure 18.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab surkh roshni ko 'low intensity' aur neeli ko 'high intensity' likhti hai, lekin asal baat shiddat nahi, frequency hai: surkh roshni kitni hi tez kyun na ho, sodium se electron nahi nikalti, kyunke us ki frequency threshold frequency fo se kam hai; neeli roshni dheemi ho tab bhi electrons nikalti hai.

Yeh nataij roshni ki electromagnetic lehar theory se samjhaye nahi ja sakte. Us theory ke mutabiq shiddat barhane se nikalne wale electrons ki kinetic energy barhni chahiye, jo tajurbe ke khilaf hai; aur kam frequency ki roshni bhi aakhir electrons azad karne ke liye kafi tawanai de deni chahiye, jo nahi hota.

Einstein ne Planck ka khayal aage barhaya: roshni photons naam ke quanta mein kharij ya jazb hoti hai, har aik ki tawanai E = hf. Photon dhaat ki satah ke aik electron se jazb hota hai. Electron ko dhaat se nikalne ke liye kam se kam tawanai, work function phi, chahiye. Agar photon ki tawanai kafi ho to electron foran nikal jata; photon ki tawanai ka kuch hissa electron azad karta aur baqi us ki kinetic energy ban jati: aane wale photon ki tawanai - work function = photoelectron ki (K.E.)max, ya hf - phi = (1/2) m vmax^2 (18.5). Yeh Einstein ki photoelectric equation hai.

Jab (K.E.)max sifar ho to f threshold frequency fo ke barabar hai, is liye hfo - phi = 0, ya phi = hfo (18.6). Einstein ki equation (K.E.)max = hf - hfo (18.7) bhi likhi ja sakti hai. Har nikalne wale electron ki kinetic energy zyada se zyada nahi hoti: kuch seedhe satah se nikalte jab ke kuch pehle takkaron mein tawanai khote hain, aur equation 18.7 sirf un par laagu hai jo poori faltu tawanai le kar nikalte hain. Frequency ke muqable (K.E.)max ka graph h dhalwan ki seedhi lakeer hai jo fo se shuru hoti; fo se neeche koi emission nahi. Einstein ko photoelectric effect samjhane par 1921 ka Physics Nobel Prize mila. Agar roshni aisi lehar ho jis ki tawanai wavefront par barabar phaili ho to yeh asar samjhaya nahi ja sakta; yeh roshni ki zarrati fitrat dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Photoelectrons ki K.E.max aur roshni ki frequency f ka graph. Seedhi lakeer f-mehwar (axis) ko threshold frequency fo par kaatti aur daen taraf oopar jati hai; mehwar ke neeche yeh dashed lakeer ban kar K.E.max mehwar tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy aur roshni ki frequency ka graph; aik khaas frequency fo se neeche photoemission nahi hota (kitab ke box wale graph ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Lakeer ki dhalwan (slope) h hai, har dhaat ke liye aik jaisi, kyunke (K.E.)max = hf - phi. Lakeer f-mehwar ko fo par kaatti hai; dashed hissa peeche barhaya jaye to K.E.max mehwar ko -phi par kaatta hai. Kitab ke box ki ibarat 'below a certain frequency f' likhti hai; durust 'fo' hai.

450 nm wavelength ki neeli roshni ke photon ki tawanai eV mein maloom karein. Hal: E = hf = hc/lambda = (6.63 x 10^-34 J s)(3 x 10^8 m s^-1)/(450 x 10^-9 m) = 4.42 x 10^-19 J. Kyunke 1 eV = 1.6 x 10^-19 J, E = 4.42 x 10^-19 / 1.6 x 10^-19 = 2.76 eV.

577 nm wavelength ki peeli roshni caesium ki satah par parti aur stopping voltage 0.25 V hai. (a) photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada K.E. aur (b) caesium ka work function maloom karein. Hal: (a) (K.E.)max = Vo e = 0.25 V x 1.6 x 10^-19 C = 4 x 10^-20 J = 0.25 eV. (b) phi = hc/lambda - (K.E.)max = (6.63 x 10^-34 x 3 x 10^8)/(577 x 10^-9) - 4 x 10^-20 = 3.45 x 10^-19 J - 0.40 x 10^-19 J = 3.05 x 10^-19 J, jo 1.9 eV hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Electromagnetic shuaon ka maddah se amal photon ki tawanai par munhasir hai: kam tawanai (taqreeban 0.5 MeV se kam) par photoelectric effect ghalib; darmiyani tawanai par Compton effect ghalib; zyada tawanai (taqreeban 1.2 MeV se zyada) par pair production ghalib hai.

blocks.prompt: Roshni ki shiddat barhane se photocurrent kyun barhta hai lekin photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Tez roshni fi second zyada photons lati hai, is liye zyada electrons nikalte aur current barhta hai; lekin har photon ki tawanai ab bhi hf hai, is liye har electron ki zyada se zyada tawanai, hf - phi, wahi rehti hai.

items: Photoelectrons sirf threshold frequency fo se oopar nikalte.
(1/2) m vmax^2 = Vo e; hf - phi = (K.E.)max; phi = hfo.
Shiddat electrons ki tadaad; frequency un ki zyada se zyada tawanai tay karti.
